summary:
About Me

Hi there, my name is Michiel, a life enthusiast and mental health advocate on a mission to inspire, motivate, and break barriers while figuring out what I want to do for a living. Over the years, I’ve tackled smoking, weed, and porn addiction, learning the power of resilience and self-forgiveness.

This blog is a space where I explore self-help, personal growth, and topics society often hesitates to discuss. It’s my way of documenting the steps I’m taking to become a better version of myself and learning to embrace life with all its imperfections —and maybe inspire you to do the same.
